CustomObject.description: The TurboSign Recipient is a child of TurboSign Envelope and mirrors one signer's state from the TurboSign API. It holds the TurboDocx Recipient Id (external ID), name, Email, Signing Order, raw and effective status, and the per-signer delivery counters (Total Sent, Reminder Count, Warning Count) with their timestamps. Commonly used for per-signer analysis and roll-ups.
CustomObject.label: TurboSign Recipient
